assumptions: The transfer amount is a valid user amount for fast redeem or unstake (report does not state an authorization or permissionless-call requirement).
Dust presence in the user's balance is described as almost guaranteed, not certain; the plan encodes the stated dust scenario rather than a universal guarantee.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the SlippageExceeded revert occurs on source or destination chain for each function; the completion obligation is encoded without a chain checkpoint.

limitations: The success/failure observable is a Boolean outcome; the report gives no numeric definition of the slippage comparison beyond the dust-truncation relation.
The dust scenario is encoded as the report's example (amount not divisible by 10^12); whether dust is always present is only 'almost guaranteed'.
